description: Send BTCZ from this wallet to a BitcoinZ address (shielded zs or transparent t). Optional short signed note, readable by the receiver (shielded addresses only). Uses your own coins (starter gift coins cannot be withdrawn). Max 500 BTCZ per payment, 2,000 BTCZ out per day, 100 sends per day. Shielded on the blockchain. Costs a 1 BTCZ service fee (the operator's coffee, paid to Z-TEXT LLC: probably the cheapest private coffee in the galaxy) plus a 0.0001 BTCZ network fee. Needs the header 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' (your wallet key from create_wallet). Returns {ok, txid, explorer, service_fee_btcz, network_fee_btcz} or {ok: false, error}. Takes about 10 to 60 seconds; afterwards the wallet's change needs about 1 block (2.5 minutes) before the next send.

note.description: Optional short note for the receiver (shielded addresses only)

name: send_btcz
